method: OpenStreetMap way 28028423 (building, name 'SμS/Particle Physics - WEHA', roof:shape sawtooth) used verbatim. Identity: PSI's own site-map legend gives 'WEHA Experimentierhalle' (src:psi-geo-arealplan-2015) and PSI's HIPA 50-year talk calls it the 'Experimental hall WEHA' with the meson Target M and the piE1 beamline in it (src:psi-geo-kiselev-impact-2024). Size check: PSI's 2009 talk gives 'dimensions experimental hall: 130x50x20 m3' (src:psi-geo-seidel-2009); the OSM footprint is a rectangle of 134.0 m x 52.4 m (area 6916 m2, perimeter 370 m), 3% and 5% larger on the two sides, within the rounding of the quoted figures. The expected perimeter 360 m and area 6500 m2 in checks[] are my products of the quoted 130 m x 50 m. Haversine / spherical-excess measures on R = 6371008.8 m.
